concretechanges.before: Forgetting is not passive decay. It is an active architectural process — a structure with walls, ducts, and a ventilation system that actively pumps certain memories out while recirculating others.
concretechanges.after: Institutional forgetting can be read as architecture: a structure with walls, ducts and a ventilation system that pumps certain memories out while recirculating others.

concretechanges.before: That is not oversight. It is design.
concretechanges.after: The scene makes me ask what directs attention. It cannot, by itself, establish deliberate suppression.

concretechanges.before: The response was not a paradigm shift but a timeline expansion: absorb the anomaly while keeping the explanatory framework intact. The structure adapts without learning.
concretechanges.after: A revised timeline can represent learning as well as accommodation. To argue that the framework resisted the evidence, we would need to examine its actual revisions.

concretechanges.before: The Ministry of Culture does not fund digs that undermine the national story.
concretechanges.after: The possibility that funding favours a national story deserves examination in particular cases.

concretechanges.before: The detailed Antarctic coastline — drawn before the ice sheet was supposedly surveyed — is treated as a fortunate accident. The map is not debated. It is diminished.
concretechanges.after: The claim that it depicts an Antarctic coastline is itself disputed. It cannot serve here as established evidence of suppression; the argument would need to compare the map, proposed identifications and their sources.

concretechanges.before: The triad is not a metaphor. It is a diagnostic.
concretechanges.after: The observer, institution and resistance form an interpretive lens here, rather than a validated diagnostic.

concretechanges.before: All three co-arise, or nothing arises. The work is not to recover the lost knowledge. The work is to build the architecture that can hold it without collapse.
concretechanges.after: The work includes building institutions that can hold difficult evidence without deciding in advance what it must mean.

concretechanges.before: The system does not fail. It succeeds at what it was designed to do: maintain coherence. To remember what has been metabolized requires not more excavation but more witnesses. The question is not whether the past is buried. The question is who is looking, and what body they have built to carry what they see.
concretechanges.after: A claim of cultural amnesia has to expose its own selection process, too. Which records support it, which resist it, and who can inspect both? Otherwise the architecture of forgetting is an accusation we can aim at every closed door while keeping our own archive locked.
